paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with CAST-CAPP
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 5 (left)
notes: CAST-CAPP haloscope search at CERN (4124 h, 2019-2021) covering 4.774-5.434 GHz (19.74-22.47 ueV). The paper reports a mass-dependent exclusion curve (Fig. 5) but no numerical table; only the best/headline value g_agamma = 8e-14 GeV^-1 at 90% CL is stated in text (best sensitivity near ~22 ueV due to phase-matching). The two data points span the searched mass range at the quoted best limit; the actual limit is somewhat weaker over parts of the band, so treat as approximate. Assumes virialized galactic axions with local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 44)) | Vision: Figure 5 (left panel) shows the CAST-CAPP 90% CL exclusion (red) on |g_agamma| vs m_a c^2 over 19.74-22.47 ueV; x-axis linear in ueV, y-axis log from 1e-15 to 1e-11 GeV^-1. Lower boundary is highly jagged (spiky) due to resonant scan; points trace the lower envelope of the excluded region. Deepest sensitivity ~8e-14 GeV^-1 near 22 ueV, matching text quote, due to predominant phase-matching there.
